name: io.github.tradewr333-lgtm/degenscan-intel
title: Degenscan Intel
description: Cross-asset event intelligence for trading agents: SEC, Fed, Federal Register, USGS, NHC, Nasdaq halts, DefiLlama, Polymarket and 30+ primary sources normalized into one event schema and scored against an exposure graph into per-asset impacts (stocks, ETFs, crypto, commodities, rates). Pay per call in USDC via x402 or with an API key.

headers.name: X-API-KEY
headers.description: Optional subscription key (see /v1/plans). Without it: 100 free calls/day, then x402 (USDC on Base) per call.
